qualificationWorkload.selection: Seeded random enabled source heroes, no duplicates in the ten-hero fixture; selection PRNG is independent of battle RNG
qualificationWorkload.gear: All four job-compatible source Mythic T4 equipment positions, quality13, enhancement5, faction and hero binding attributes
qualificationWorkload.beastNormalization: Explicit benchmark choice: source normal mythic beast quality10, level360, eight distinct source InitTalentID talents at each talent's highest supplied quality
qualificationWorkload.battleTermination: Original BattleEngine rules; no shortened benchmark timeout or substituted winner

sourceEvidence: Eligible hero must have UnitType=Hero, Enable=true, MaxQuality>=15, UnitQuality[tid][15], UnitRank[tid][20], Signature[tid].MaxLevel>=30, and SignatureLevel[tid][30]
Equip records define Job and Position; EquipQuality[13] is Mythic T4 with MaxEnhanceLevel=5
equipData.setAndGet derives cfg_id and quality from raw tid and source Equip table; raw attrs are a name/value object
signatureData.setAndGet reads lv and validates raw quality against SignaturePower[0].QualityLimit
BattleEngine.initPetInfo reads config.pets.self_pets/oppo_pets and invokes original UnitCreate on each PetData
PetData constructor and updateTalent build original PetTalent objects; mythic quality10 getTalentCountByQuality returns8

reuseBoundary.shared: JSON-wire scenario configuration and decoded source tables may be reused read-only
reuseBoundary.perBattle: Materialization creates fresh original equipData, signatureData, PetData, talents, hero arrays and config objects
reuseBoundary.notClaimed: This factory does not prove whole-battle fidelity or qualify a throughput number

modeNote: Mode and battleId are explicit inputs. stage uses original source stage rules; idle_pvp can add its original FieldNPC mechanics rather than suppressing them.

qualificationV2.legacyCompatibility: createRealisticScenario retains cross-distinct default and exact frozen seed2026 wire hash
